artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image features a woman standing. She is angled slightly to the left with her head turned slightly to the right, looking ahead. The woman has an oval face, soft features, a traditional hairstyle, and is wearing a kimono with a dark outer layer and a floral inner layer near the collar. She has an obi tied around her waist with a knot at the back featuring a landscape design. The woman is barefoot on woven flooring, with a neutral background and a soft, circular vignette effect around the edges.

artworks.title: Mendicant Nun
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. She is facing forward but with her head slightly turned, looking off to the side. Her facial expression appears calm, and she has dark, medium-length hair covered by a purple headscarf. She is wearing a layered ensemble comprising a long, dark robe over a light-colored kimono, tied at the waist with a purple sash. She is holding a small child in her arms, wrapped in a cloth with earthy tones. The woman is barefoot, and in the background, there is a large, woven bamboo basket leaning against the wall on a checkered pattern floor against a blank background.

artworks.title: An Architectural Capriccio with a Triumphal Arch
artworks.medium: pen and gray and black ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image depicts a grand architectural drawing with a central perspective view leading through a monumental archway. The point of view is straight on, showcasing the symmetrical design and scale of the arch, with columns and detailed architectural elements drawing the eye upward. The street extends beyond the archway, lined with buildings that diminish in size. The brushstrokes create depth and detail, with shading emphasizing the architecture's three-dimensional qualities. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, using shades of gray to highlight the structure's intricacies. Large figures on pedestals under the arch provide scale, and figures and horses can be seen on the distant street, adding perspective.

artworks.title: Berchtesgaden with the Watzmann Peak in the Distance
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a valley with mountains in the background. A village with buildings and trees is visible in the foreground, leading into the natural landscape. The painting style incorporates light brushstrokes with a watercolor effect. The color scheme includes soft blues and greens, with white areas suggesting unpainted sections. The chiaroscuro creates a serene atmosphere, with deeper hues in the mountains and lighter sketched areas in the foreground.

artworks.title: Bouquet of Spring Flowers in a Terracotta Vase
artworks.medium: oiled charcoal and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund, The Ahmanson Foundation Fund, Linda H. Kaufman Fund, and Mr. and Mrs. Louis Glickfield Fund
artworks.description: This painting shows a variety of flowers in a decorative light orange vase. The flowers are of a variety of sizes and colors, including bright orange, blue, white, red, and pink, surrounded by green leaves and stems. The vase is positioned centrally at the bottom of the painting, with most of the tall flowers extending upwards to the top of the painting. Some flowers also drip down the sides of the vase or lie on the surface below. The surface and the wall behind the vase are both light brown. The orange vase appears to have shapes either carved or painted on it, but they are hard to identify. The lines in this painting are loose and sketch-like, and the colors have been applied similarly, sometimes bleeding out of the outlines of the flowers.

artworks.title: A Gardener and a Gentleman
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper, laid down on an old mount
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in detailed clothing in various poses in the foreground. There is a third smaller figure present in the background on the left. The sketch has a simple background with minimal detail. The artwork is characterized by loose, flowing strokes.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child in the Clouds, Adored by Saints
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch features a group of figures, including adults and children, in various seated and standing positions. In the upper portion, two adults sit with a child between them on clouds. The figures have simple facial features and different hair styles. The lower portion shows another group of figures, with a central standing figure holding a book, surrounded by other standing and seated figures in robes. The background is minimal, focusing on the space between the upper and lower sections. The image is drawn in ink with brown and black tones.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé

artworks.title: Seated Nude Seen from Above
artworks.medium: pastel on yellow paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a woman's torso in a seated position. Her body is facing slightly sideways, with her head leaning downwards. She has medium-length wavy hair and is holding a white cloth in her right hand. The background is textured in blue with a worn cream border.

artworks.title: A Road through a Country Village
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from an elevated perspective. The horizon is low in the composition with scattered trees and a simple structure. The brushstrokes are delicate and sketch-like, creating a sense of movement. The color palette is soft, primarily earthy browns and greens. Close to us, there is a wide expanse of land with a dirt path leading to the house in the distance. Trees flank both sides, adding depth. The sky is depicted with a pale wash, indicating overcast weather. The artwork conveys a calm and expansive natural environment.

artworks.title: A Meadow with a Shepherd and Goats at the Edge of a Forest
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink over black chalk on two joined sheets of wove sketchbook paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a sepia-toned palette. The viewpoint is from ground level, showing a wooded scene with a clearing or slope on the left and tree-filled horizon. The sky is cloudy with wispy brushstrokes. Trees dominate the right side with detailed and sketchy strokes. The scene has light filtering through foliage, and grassy patches with sloping terrain and shadowed areas. The color scheme consists of browns, blacks, and hints of gray, reminiscent of early photographic tones or aged ink drawings.

artworks.title: The Castle of Bürglen with the Alps Beyond
artworks.medium: watercolor and black chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with lush vegetation viewed from above, with a path leading into the distance. Snow-capped mountains are visible in the background, and there is a building with a peaked roof nestled among trees slightly to the right of the center. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, especially for the trees and foliage. The color palette is dominated by green tones in the vegetation, contrasting with earth tones in the winding path. A figure is walking along the path, and the sky is painted in soft blues and whites with hints of gray.

artworks.title: Air
artworks.artist: Jost Amman, after Wenzel Jamnitzer I
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof without text]
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 25.5 x 17.8 cm (10 1/16 x 7 in.) (cut within platemark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate ornamental design with various mythical elements. The central focus of the image is a large, blank, vase-like shape that is surrounded by intricate decorative motifs. Above the vase, there are cherubic figures playing musical instruments, perched amidst swirling architectural forms and ornate scrolls. At the top center, a head with puffy cheeks appears to be blowing air, flanked by geometric shapes and foliage. The sides feature winged creatures, likely representing cherubs, each engaged in different activities. Birds with grand, outstretched wings are positioned at the bottom, as if guarding the central medallion. The entire composition is richly detailed with motifs of leaves, insects, and animals, creating a fantastical and harmonious balance.

artworks.title: Water
artworks.artist: Jost Amman, after Wenzel Jamnitzer I
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof without text]
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 25.8 x 17.8 cm (10 3/16 x 7 in.) (cut within platemark)
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and curved shapes forming an abstract design. A scallop shell is at the center, encircled by cherubic figures, dragons, and sea creatures. Abstract motifs of flowers, shells, and mythical beasts are present, along with arrows and shields, creating a fantastical scene merging nature and mythology.

artworks.title: A Bald Man in Profile (The Artist's Father?)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 6.7 x 5.7 cm (2 5/8 x 2 1/4 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man's profile. The man is turned to the right, with his head slightly bowed. His facial features are prominent with a strong nose, and he has a partial beard. The man has a receding hairline, leaving a mostly bald head with hair only on the sides and lower back. He appears to be wearing a garment with a textured fabric, possibly a fur collar or coat. The background is filled with dense, swirling etching lines. The corner of the etching is signed and dated with an 'RL' monogram and the year '1630.'

artworks.title: Christ Dying on the Cross
artworks.artist: Jean Morin, after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching from two plates on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a crucifixion pose, suspended from a wooden cross. The man has a crown of thorns on his head, his eyes partially closed, and is wearing a cloth around his waist. He is surrounded by a detailed cityscape with architectural structures and a cloudy sky in the background. There is text above and below the image.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a man with a muscular build seated against a large tree, with a cloth around his waist. He has one hand on his knee and the other arm propped against the trunk. He has a full beard and wavy hair, with three cherubic figures, a lion, and an open book around him. The background shows a detailed, leafy tree covering much of the sky with a few clouds visible in the distance.

artworks.title: The Sabine Hills and Rocca Santo Stefano Seen from Civitella
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape drawing showing rolling hills and distant mountain peaks. The viewpoint appears elevated, providing a panoramic view of the terrain with the horizon high up in the image. The pencil strokes are light and precise, creating a delicate texture that depicts the softness of the landscape. The drawing is monochromatic, using shades of grey to convey a sense of calmness. There are hills in the foreground leading towards the mountains in the distance, under a faint line of clouds above.

artworks.title: Ancient Oaks in a Landscape
artworks.artist: Wilhelm von Kobell, after Jan Wijnants
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sepia-toned landscape print. It features a detailed and gnarled old oak tree dominating the left side of the print. Large leafy plants are visible at the tree's base. In the background to the right, there is a wooden fence, fields, and a softly rendered mountain. Faint outlines of buildings and trees are seen along the horizon. The brushstroke technique captures detailed tree bark, foliage, and clouds realistically. The color palette is predominantly brown, giving the image a warm and aged appearance.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man seated on a rock, draped with a cloth around his waist. He is positioned in front of a large tree. The man has long hair and a beard. He is holding a cross, which is resting on a rock nearby. Next to him is a lion and two cherubic children, one holding a book. The background shows more trees, hills, and a clear sky. The etching is detailed and in a classical style.

artworks.title: The Music Room of Archduchess Margarete, Princess of Saxony, in Schloss Ambras
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and metallic paint over graphite with scraping and gum on cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a large green ceramic heater on the left, a blue upholstered chaise lounge in front of it, and a grand piano on the right side of the room. The color palette consists of warm browns and yellows on the walls and floor, with accents of green and blue from the heater and chaise lounge. Central to the ceiling is a black chandelier, and a large window with open wooden shutters on the back wall lets in light. A well-decorated surface with various smaller objects adorns the table near the window, and there are two birdcages positioned to the right near the piano.

artworks.title: Frédéric Auguste III, roi de Pologne
artworks.artist: Pierre Drevet, after François de Troy
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a person from the waist up, facing slightly to the right within an oval frame. The person has a prominent nose, full lips, curly hair, and wears regal attire. The oval frame includes text at the top denoting a title. Below the oval, there is a crest or coat of arms on an elaborate pedestal, surrounded by detailed engraving. The background is filled with intricate engraved lines.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. The scene depicts a classical figure reclining on a draped surface in a lush forest setting, with a small winged figure in the center carrying a basket above its head. The background is filled with dense trees and two birds flying in the sky. There are additional figures partially obscured by the forest canopy. The drawing utilizes a technique of intricate linework to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Prise de la Bastille, le 14 Juillet 1789
artworks.medium: etching [undescribed proof] on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The illustration shows a tumultuous scene with a group of individuals engaged in combat in front of a large building. Dense clouds of smoke rise upward, indicating gunfire or cannon discharge. In the middle distance, another group appears to be advancing with raised weapons. The background includes towering structures partially obscured by smoke, and foliage suggesting a tree line or garden. The composition conveys movement and urgency as figures react to the events around them.
